:::{#exm-deriv-linear-map}
#### Derivative of a linear map

Let $\matr{A} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ ($1 \times 2$) and $\vcoef = \tp{(\coef{1}, \coef{2})}$.
Then $\matr{A}\vcoef = 2\coef{1} + 3\coef{2}$, and by @thm-deriv-linear-map:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef}(\matr{A}\vcoef)}_{2 \times 1}
&= \underbrace{\tp{\matr{A}}}_{2 \times 1} \\
&= \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\
3 \end{pmatrix}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
